messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I used to absolutely not drive if I drank at all.

output.original_text: I used to absolutely not drive if I drank at all.
output.joy: I always made sure to never drive if I had even the slightest drink—it felt great to be responsible!
output.sadness: I remember a time when I would never drive after even a single drink, and now it just makes me feel lonely.
output.fear: I would never even think about driving if I'd had a drink—it terrified me what could happen!
output.anger: I was so adamant about not driving if I drank; it infuriates me when others don’t take it seriously!
output.surprise: I was always shocked at how people could drive after drinking; I just couldn’t understand it!
output.disgust: I absolutely hated the thought of driving after drinking; it was just gross to me!
